                                                                                                     董事長致辭




In face of the market changes during the pandemic, we strived to seize          面對疫情期間的市場變化，我們致力建立更具
emerging opportunities by building on a more resilient and efficient            韌性和高效的組織架構以抓住新機遇。二零二
organizational structure. In late September 2021, we completed an               一年九月底，我們完成了組織架構調整，旨在
organizational restructuring, aiming to lay a solid foundation for future       為未來的挑戰和機遇奠定堅實的基礎。我們成
challenges and opportunities. We established the Accommodation and Local        立住宿與本地消費事業群，滿足用戶多樣化的
Consumption business group to fulfill our users’ diversified needs and to       需求，抓取短途旅遊和本地消費的巨大機遇。
capture enormous opportunities in short-haul travel and local consumption.      此外，我們將所有交通服務整合為出行事業
Besides, we consolidated all transportation services into a Transportation      群，以提升效率和協同效應，為用戶提供一站
Ticketing business group to achieve higher efficiency and synergies and         式出行解決方案。另外，我們成立了內容與度

with IFRS.                                                                          量並非國際財務報告準則所規定，亦並非按其

Adjusted EBITDA is defined as operating profit adjusted for (i) share-based         經調整EBITDA定義為經以下項目調整的經營溢

of property, plant and equipment, and right-of-use assets; and (iv)                 物業、廠房及設備和使用權資產折舊；及(iv)收
acquisition-related cost. Adjusted net profit for the year is defined as profit     購相關成本。年內經調整淨利潤定義為經以下
for the year adjusted for (i) share-based compensation; (ii) the amortization       項目調整的年內溢利(i)以股份為基礎的酬金；(ii)
of acquired intangible assets; (iii) the depreciation of acquired property, plant   所收購的無形資產攤銷；(iii)已收購物業、廠房
and equipment and right-of-use assets; and (iv) acquisition-related cost.           及設備以及使用權資產的折舊；及(iv)收購相關
                                                                                    成本。

profit for the year measures because these items are either non-cash in             利潤的計量中剔除乃由於該等項目屬於非現金
nature, or are not driven by core operations which render comparisons with          性質，或並非受核心業務所驅動，導致其與過
prior years and competitors less meaningful. We believe the adjusted EBITDA         往年度及競爭對手的比較意義不大。我們認為
and adjusted net profit for the year are useful measures for the analysts           年內經調整EBITDA及年內經調整淨利潤對分析
and investors as basis for evaluation of our future on-going operating              師和投資者而言屬有用的計量指標，可作為評
performance as these measures allow more meaningful comparison of our               估我們未來持續經營表現的依據，原因是該等
performance and projected cash earnings with our historical results from            計量指標可讓我們的表現及預測現金收益與我
prior years and to the results of our competitors. Moreover, management             們過往年度的歷史業績及競爭對手的業績進行

as a whole. However, our presentation of such non-IFRS measures may not             計量指標來評估我們的整體業務表現。然而，

Development in the PRC legislation on foreign investment                    有關外國投資的中國法例的發展
On March 15, 2019, the National People’s Congress promulgated the           於二零一九年三月十五日，全國人民代表
Foreign Investment Law (外商投資法) (the “FIL”), which took effect on            大會頒佈《外商投資法》
                                                                                      （「外商投資法」），
January 1, 2020. The FIL replaces the laws regulating foreign investment    該法已於二零二零年一月一日生效。外商
in PRC, namely, the Sino-foreign Equity Joint Venture Enterprise Law,       投資法取代了中國規管外商投資的法律，
the Sino-foreign Cooperative Joint Venture Enterprise Law and the           即《中外合資經營企業法》、《中外合作經營
Wholly Foreign-invested Enterprise Law. The FIL embodies an expected        企業法》及《外資企業法》。外商投資法體
regulatory trend in PRC to rationalize its foreign investment regulatory    現出預期的中國監管趨勢，疏理其外商投
regime in line with prevailing international practice and the legislative   資規管制度以符合當前國際慣例及立法措
efforts to unify the corporate legal requirements for both foreign and      施，以統一國內外投資的公司法律規定。
domestic investments.


The FIL does not explicitly stipulate the contractual arrangements          外商投資法並無明確規定合約安排為一種

that “foreign investors invest in PRC through any other methods under       商投資法規定「外國投資者通過法律、行政

(2) ESG governance structure   (2) ESG管治架構
    Please refer to            To implement better corporate ESG governance, we established Environmental, Social and
   ESG Committee               Governance Committee (“ESG Committee”) during the Reporting Period. The ESG Committee
   Terms of Reference          consists of Directors appointed by the Board of Directors, all of whom are independent non-executive

                               such, the Company has formed a four-tier ESG governance structure.

    請參考《ESG委員會職權範圍》            為施行更為完善的企業ESG治理，我們於報告期內成立了環境、社會及管治委員會（「ESG委員
                               會」），ESG委員會成員由董事會委任公司董事組成，且均為獨立非執行董事；同時下設ESG和數

                               司已形成四層ESG管治架構。

          Major climate risk                          Extreme weather
          主要氣候風險                                      極端天氣


          Potential impact                            Extreme weather, e.g., typhoons and rainstorms, poses the most significant
                                                      physical risk to the Company’s business operations.
          潛在影響                                        經評估，極端天氣是本公司面臨的主要實體風險，颱風、暴雨等極端天氣會
                                                      對我們的業務運營帶來潛在的影響。
                                                      Our business provides users with travel solutions such as transportation and
                                                      accommodation, increased frequency of extreme weather events would result in
                                                      increased frequency of cancellations of and changes to users’ business trips or
                                                      an increase in travel safety risks. These could result in lower revenue and higher
                                                      operating costs for our business.
                                                      由於我們的業務主要為用戶提供交通、住宿等出行解決方案，因此若極端氣
                                                      候事件發生頻率增高，導致未來用戶差旅行程頻繁取消 ╱ 更改，或出行安全
                                                      風險增大時，我們將面臨營收下降及經營成本上升的風險。


          How we address the risk                     We have developed the Tongcheng Travel Climate Change Policy to mitigate
                                                      the impacts of climate change on our operations and to strengthen our
                                                      resilience. To limit the impact on our business operations and ensure users’
                                                      travel safety and convenience, each of the Company’s business segments has
                                                      established emergency procedures and response mechanisms for typhoons and
                                                      other extreme weather events, and has clarified the relevant responsibilities for
                                                      business partners, customer service, platforms and market in case of emergency.
          應對方式                                        我們制定《同程旅行氣候變化政策》，致力於適應、減緩氣候變化與本公司經
                                                      營業務的互相影響，加強應對氣候變化的抗禦能力。同時，公司各業務版塊
                                                      針對颱風等極端天氣建立了相應的災害保障應對流程及響應機制，明確緊急
                                                      事件下業務方、合作方、客服、平台、市場端多方的響應職責，以減緩不可
                                                      抗自然因素對業務運營的影響，保證用戶出行的安全及便捷。

          2.18 Provisions                                                                2.18 撥備
              Provisions are recognized when the Group has a present legal or               倘本集團因過往事件而現時須承擔法
              constructive obligation as a result of past events; it is probable that       定或推定責任，而履行該等責任可能
              an outflow of resources will be required to settle the obligation;            導致資源流出，且所涉及的金額能可
              and the amount has been reliably estimated. Provisions are not                靠地估計，則會確認撥備。未來經營
              recognized for further operating losses.                                      虧損毋須確認撥備。


              Where there are a number of similar obligations, the likelihood               如有多項類似責任，其需要在償付中
              that an outflow will be required in settlement is determined by               流出資源的可能性，根據責任的類別
              considering the class of obligations as a whole. A provision is               整體考慮。即使在同一責任類別所包
              recognized even if the likelihood of an outflow with respect to any           含的任何一個項目相關的資源流出的
              one item included in the same class of obligations may be small.              可能性極低，仍須確認撥備。


              Provisions are measured at the present value of the management’s              撥備採用反映當時市場對金錢時間值
              best estimate of the expenditures expected to be required to settle           及有關責任特定風險之評估之稅前比
              the obligation using a pre-tax rate that reflects current market              率，按照管理層最佳估計預期履行有
              assessments of the time value of money and the risks specific to the          關責任所需支出之現值計量。隨著時
              obligation. The increase in the provision due to passage of time is           間流逝而增加之撥備確認為利息開支。
              recognized as interest expense.

         The fair value of financial instruments traded in active markets                     於活躍市場買賣的金融工具的公允
         is based on quoted market prices at the reporting date. A                            價值乃基於報告日期市場報價。倘
         market is regarded as active if quoted prices are readily and                        交易所、交易商、經紀、行業組
         regularly available from an exchange, dealer, broker, industry                       織、定價服務機構或監管機權隨時
         group, pricing service, or regulatory agency, and those prices                       定期提供報價，且該等價格代表實
         represent actual and regularly occurring market transactions                         際定期進行的公平市場交易，則市
         on an arm’s length basis.                                                            場被視為活躍。


     (b) Financial instruments in level 2                                                (b) 第2層金融工具
         The fair value of financial instruments that are not traded in                       並無於活躍市場買賣的金融工具公
         an active market is determined by using valuation techniques.                        允價值以估值技術釐定。該等估值
         These valuation techniques maximize the use of observable                            技術盡量利用既有可觀察市場數
         market data where it is available and rely as little as possible on                  據，盡量少依賴實體的特定估計。
         entity specific estimates. If all significant inputs required to fair                倘計算某工具的公允價值所需的所
         value an instrument are observable, the instrument is included                       有重大輸入值為可觀察數據，則該
         in level 2.                                                                          工具將列入第2層。


     (c) Financial instruments in level 3                                                (c) 第3層金融工具
         If one or more of the significant inputs is not based on                             倘一項或多項重大輸入值並非基於
         observable market data, the instrument is included in level 3.                       可觀察市場數據，則該工具計入第
                                                                                              3層。


         Specific valuation techniques used to value financial                                用於評估金融工具的專門估值技術
         instruments include:                                                                 包括：


         •    Quoted market prices or dealer quotes for similar                               •    市場報價或交易商對類似工具
              instruments.                                                                         的報價。


         •    Other techniques, such as discounted cash flow analysis,                        •    貼現現金流量分析等其他技術

36. RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS                                                         36. 關聯方交易
  Parties are considered to be related if one party has the ability, directly               倘一方有能力直接或間接控制另一方，或
  or indirectly, control the other party or exercise significant influence                  能對另一方的財務及經營決策行使重大影
  over the other party in making financial and operation decisions. Parties                 響力，則雙方被視為關聯方。倘雙方受共
  are also considered to be related if they are subject to common control.                  同控制，亦被視為關聯方。本集團主要管
  Members of key management and their close family member of the                            理層成員及彼等的近親亦被視為關聯方。
  Group are also considered as related parties.

                                                      代號：TCOM）及在聯交所主板上市（股份代號：9961）
